scientific_integrity: The known spin-factor multiplication and trace/norm quadratic identity are credited; the pointwise finite-field fibers and their counting consequences are the asserted contribution. Exhaustive checks are not substituted for general proof.
scientific_limitations: Odd finite fields and nondegenerate bilinear dimension at least 2 only. Set-theoretic square-root counts; scheme-theoretic fibers are not determined. General proof uses classical quadratic Gauss sums. Historical priority against unindexed equivalent formulations is not assured.
title: Square-root fibers, quartic ramification, and Witt-sensitive images in finite spin-factor Jordan algebras
